about_short_description.short_description: The Helicopter Company is a commercial helicopter transportation service company that caters to the wealthy and influential.

product.name: Helicopter Emergency Medical Services (HEMS)
product.description: Helicopter-based emergency medical transport for critical-care patients, using medically equipped aircraft and specialized flight and medical crews.

product.name: Private Charters
product.description: On-demand VIP helicopter transportation for business and leisure travel within Saudi Arabia, tailored to passenger schedules and destinations.

product.name: Aerial Work
product.description: Specialized helicopter operations for filming, aerial surveying, banner towing, and other project-specific activities requiring an aircraft and professional crew.

product.name: Tourism
product.description: Helicopter sightseeing and excursion flights providing aerial access to Saudi Arabia’s landscapes, landmarks, cultural sites, and other attractions.

product.name: Aircraft Maintenance, Repair and Operations (MRO)
product.description: Maintenance, repair, and operational support for helicopters under THC’s licensed aviation maintenance activities.

product.name: Aviation Training
product.description: Pilot and maintenance training through THC’s Qimam Aviation program, supporting the development of Saudi aviation personnel.
